name: Dead Man’s Ink
body:
School universal; Level bard 1, cleric 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 minute
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target 1 dead creature and one target creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

When you cast this spell, you can remove an enchanted tattoo from a slain target and place it upon the skin of a willing subject, including, if you choose, yourself. You cannot use this spell to place an enchanted tattoo which requires an open magic item slot upon a creature which already has that slot occupied by an enchanted tattoo.
